text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day around noon, when I visited the 
Expedition Support Committee—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —...Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal. ...How was it, 
Orfe?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The flavor of the alfonsino comes through 
beautifully. It was truly delicious.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then we shall continue sourcing 
from this vendor.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san. Would you like some as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ochazuke.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the two of them absolutely 
love ochazuke, and often go out to eat it 
or experiment with tasty new ways to 
prepare it.
choice_data_list: You really love ochazuke that much, huh?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My father was quite fond of it too, 
so I have eaten it often ever since 
childhood.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"It's easy to prepare, yet the 
combinations are endless. Which rice, 
which tea, which broth to choose... The 
deeper your dedication, the richer the 
world becomes."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Above all... that gentle flavor is truly 
one of a kind. Right, Or?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Separating the rice from the broth 
and savoring them alternately is quite 
pleasant in its own right.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Get the broth ready first, maaann! Soaking 
it till it's dripping wet is the best way 
to eat it!
choice_data_list: So you like ochazuke too, huh.
So you like ochazuke too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You bet! I'm always throwin' down with 
these guys over tea, too.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Golshi-san's fresh ideas are always 
quite entertaining.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this is no time to be shooting the 
breeze! Journey, we're in serious trouble!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"GOG" is ruined! It's the end of the 
wooorld!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where Gold Ship took me was a mountain of 
bowls... and every single one was filled 
with what looked like ochazuke.
choice_data_list: What the heck is this!? What's going on!?
What is this!? What's going on!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Russian... ochazuke... Ha... of all 
people, for me to... How pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Since she said she wasn't interested in 
chazuke, I put a winning bowl in one out 
of every thousand. âSuper-spicy, 
super-bitter, super-wasabi chazuke!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"A thrilling gamble like this... There's 
no way I'd pass it up. Of course... I 
managed to hit the jackpot on the first 
try—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"The rice keeps soaking up the broth and 
swelling up bigger and bigger! No matter 
how much I eat, I can't keep up...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Even as we speak... Ahh! Our fun "Gold 
Ochazuke Gig" has turned into a demonic 
festival!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I was looking forward to the Ochazuke 
Festival... What a shame. So, you came to 
ask for my help with that?
choice_data_list: Huh, speaking of which, where is Orfevre?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I asked to stay behind. I wanted Orfevre 
to savor the aftertaste of the meal, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, please, Journey! Our blessed 
Godmother!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey is already eating ochazuke. 
I thought she would refuse, but—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I don't know. However, someone with whom I 
shared a pot of rice... or rather, 
ochazuke, is in trouble.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can just leave them 
without helping.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's try them all on!
Let's get Orfevre to help too
Let's run around and ask for cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WOOOH!! That's our Journey, get 'em!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Receiving such encouragement, how 
could I not give it my all?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —...Thank you for the food.
choice_data_list:
A-Amazing... You finished the whole 
thing...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well, since it is a request from 
Golshi-san... ...Please, next time, do 
consult with me beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...From a quick glance, the balance 
between the rice and the broth is 
completely ruined. I wonder if this will 
suit Orfevre's palate."
choice_data_list:
She loves ochazuke, so maybe she'll like 
it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Shall I try calling out to them?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
――...The flavor has completely faded. 
Still, not bad.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"So you can enjoy things like this too. 
Truly impressive, Orfevre. Good boy..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
You're right... It really is a race 
against time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry and search for it so Rice 
doesn't swell up any further.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yay~, so much ochazuke♪ Down the hatch~♪

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...The right person for the right job, I 
suppose. This looks like it'll be settled 
in no time.
